name: Gray-Scott
header:
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<VTKFile type="ImageData" version="0.1" byte_order="LittleEndian" compressor="vtkZLibDataCompressor">
  <RD format_version="2">
    <description>
        Using an extra chemical (c) to modulate the parameters of a Gray-Scott system.
    </description>

    <rule type="formula" name="Gray-Scott" wrap="0">
        
      <param name="timestep"> 1.0    </param>
      <param name="D_a">      0.082  </param>
      <param name="D_b">      0.041  </param>
      <param name="k">        0.055  </param>
      <param name="F">        0.035  </param>

      <formula number_of_chemicals="3">
        delta_a = D_a * laplacian_a - a*b*b + F*(1.0f-a);
        delta_b = D_b * laplacian_b + a*b*b - (F+k+c*0.02f)*b;
      </formula>
      
    </rule>
    
    <initial_pattern_generator apply_when_loading="true">
      <overlay chemical="a">
        <overwrite />
        <constant value="1" />
        <everywhere />
      </overlay>
      <overlay chemical="b">
        <overwrite />
        <white_noise low="0.6" high="1" />
        <rectangle>
          <point3D x="0.2" y="0.2" z="0.4" />
          <point3D x="0.4" y="0.8" z="0.6" />
        </rectangle>
      </overlay>
      <overlay chemical="c">
        <overwrite />
        <radial_gradient val1="0" val2="1">
          <point3D x="0.5" y="0.5" z="0.5" />
          <point3D x="0" y="0" z="0" />
		</radial_gradient>
		<everywhere />
      </overlay>
    </initial_pattern_generator>
    
    <render_settings>
      <active_chemical value="b" />
      <show_displacement_mapped_surface value="false" />
    </render_settings>
    
  </RD>
  <ImageData WholeExtent="0 127 0 127 0 0"></ImageData>
</VTKFile>
